# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a small boy with a dark, sullen little face. He has black eyes that often convey hostility, mockery, or curiosity.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony is a sullen, mischievous, and impertinent boy who exhibits a swaggering air. He holds a deep prejudice against female teachers, believing they are worthless. He generally obeys his teacher with a scornful tolerance rather than true respect, and he remains unmoved by gentle lectures about proper behavior.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Traits

- sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- mischievous  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>

## History

After being taken in as an orphan nephew by Mrs. George Pye and her husband, Anthony began attending the Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. From his very first day, he took a dislike to Anne, maintaining that female teachers were useless. He engaged in misbehavior, such as pouring water down Aurelia Clay's neck, but remained completely untouched by Anne's gentle reprimands and lectures on how gentlemen ought to behave. His attitude of contempt and mockery persisted, including an incident where he strutted impertinently and mocked her during a cold morning at school. He later placed a live mouse inside Anne's desk drawer, which led Anne to punish him physically until his bravado broke and he cried.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_
